reviews.text: Everyone was very polite and courteous. My cat got the best treatment and care.

I went there for end of life services and the staff was absolutely amazing. They put us in a private room so that we can spend time with my girl before we said goodbye. They allowed me to hold her in my arms the entire time. I'm so grateful for that.

This has to be the biggest hospital I’ve ever seen. This is my 3rd week trying to schedule appointment for my cat. I called from 6:00 till 8 on the dot. I kept being told the phone lines are not on yet but technically they’re open at eight if you wait till 8 exactly to call, they will tell you all appointments are filled every single day for 3 weeks and even had my sister on a separate phone trying to call with me. at this point I might as well just go to Petco. I could’ve already gone to Petco. There are a list of other hospitals I could’ve gone to. If you have the money, avoid this place like the plague. This makes me question all their other services if they’re just as Janky.

The reception area not only was it clean, tidy ,the receptionists were all individually, courteous, listening, sharing Information &gave me my appointment. I had two occasions. The first was my 16year old male dog name Midnight. Was cremated by them and the return was speedfully.. which at that time,gave me access for my 2nd dog, which is a Shih Tzu to get an appt. for dog on t truck in upper Manhattan, which is never ever, ever,ever easy to get!! so I was thankful for that and now that my Shih Tzu is so nostalgic it seems like she’s dying slowly. And we need need an appt. Desperately. so please pray for me to be able to get an appointment for the doctor to see what her problem is??cause I truly cannot afford the Vet prices outside of the ASPCA. My last visit was $254. and told me to come back in 7 days. what??where was I gonna get that money from?? so I asked the receptionist do you have senior discounts or Medicare discounts? She said no. Go to ASPCA. That is the reason why I need the ASPCA!! thank you.

I am absolutely impressed with this clinic and incredibly grateful for the care my dog received here.

I’m currently going through a difficult financial period, and my dog needed to have his retained baby teeth removed. He was already a year old, but many of his baby teeth had never fallen out. Private clinics in Brooklyn quoted me anywhere from $1,000–$1,500 for the extractions. At this clinic, we were able to have all of his retained baby teeth removed for only $212.

Getting an appointment was probably the most difficult part. I tried for about a month before I finally figured it out. I even came to the clinic in person, but you cannot make an appointment by simply showing up. I’m very thankful to the staff at the downstairs reception desk because they explained exactly how the phone system works.

A tip for anyone trying to get an appointment: call at around 7:59 AM and use that minute to go through the automated menu and select the necessary options. The goal is to reach the line right when it opens at 8:00 AM. If you start calling at 8:00, there may already be too many people trying to get through. Appointments are made for the same day, so if you successfully reach them that morning, your appointment will be later that day.

Also, check which location serves your ZIP code. The Brooklyn, Queens, and other locations only accept certain ZIP codes. I had to go to Manhattan because that location accepts eligible ZIP codes from all five NYC boroughs. They also asked to see my Medicaid/Fidelis insurance card to confirm eligibility for their services.

Once we got there, the entire experience was wonderful. The reception staff upstairs were friendly and helpful with all of the paperwork. They immediately asked whether I needed an interpreter and which language I preferred. When we met with the medical team, an interpreter was connected by phone, so I was able to comfortably explain all of my concerns and ask every question I had.

The assistants who did the initial assessment were incredibly kind, patient, and attentive. The veterinarian was wonderful as well — she took the time to answer my questions, explain everything clearly, and discuss the treatment plan with me. We scheduled the dental surgery and also took care of my dog’s vaccinations.

The prices were honestly incredible. Our initial appointment was only around $5, the vaccinations were provided at no additional cost, and the dental surgery was $212.

The facility itself also deserves recognition. It was clean, comfortable, and well organized — honestly cleaner and more welcoming than some private veterinary clinics I have visited. There are separate waiting areas for cats and dogs, restrooms, and even an area where you can make free coffee or purchase other drinks.

On the day of the surgery, everything went smoothly. After the procedure, they called me to let me know when I could pick my dog up. They provided his medication for the next three days at no additional cost and carefully explained how to give it. They also scheduled his follow-up vaccine dose, which we have since completed.

My dog did amazingly well after both his surgery and his vaccinations, and I have nothing but positive things to say about our experience.

From the reception staff and assistants to the veterinarian who treated my dog, everyone was professional, compassionate, and genuinely helpful. Considering the quality of the medical care and service we received, I can honestly say that I have not always had an experience this good even at expensive private veterinary clinics.

Thank you to everyone who helped us. I’m extremely grateful that a place like this exists for pet owners who may not be able to afford thousands of dollars in veterinary bills.
They sure don’t like picking up their phones
The best doctors

I want to start by saying that my boy Silver has been to ASPCA a couple of times in January due to urinary blockages and was treated so well by Dr. Reilly and the entire staff. One pharmacist or vet tech stopped me before leaving and told me how much they all adored Silver.

Unfortunately, I had to make a very difficult and heart breaking decision to euthanize Silver on 8/1/26 due to a separate condition. Dr An and the lady at the front desk who checked me in were incredibly sweet and walked me through the procedures. The room was set up nicely and I was given as much time as I wanted to say goodbye to my boy. Thank you Dr An and front desk staff for your kindness during a difficult time.

Thank you ASPCA for your help when Silver needed it and then again when it was time to provide him peace. He was always in good hands with you all 🤍

IMPOSSIBLE TO GET APPOINTMENT.
phone no live person just a recording

The staff was very nice and professional. They really care about taking care of your beloved pets and stray animals. I adopted a Scottish Fold there, which is very rare to find at an adoption center. I fell deeply in love with the cat. Thank you, ASPCA, from the bottom of my heart. Thank you, Debbie, for taking care of us. We felt your love for the animals you care for. God bless you.

The area is constantly under construction so taking an uber or looking for parking is not as reliable as one might think. As for the front desk receptionists, most have an attitude prior to noontime. To ask a question regarding an account and was responded very rudely. The security guards are on alert and bring some ease when in the building. However, the main concern is who is being hired to be a front desk receptionist. Customer service is a very difficult job and if one is not up for the job than do not apply for it and give the customer attitude over a question

I am so grateful. They cared for my kitten with so much love, they did everything humanly possible. Sadly, my Oreo crossed the rainbow bridge and is now free from suffering. The staff is incredibly empathetic; you can't imagine how wonderful they were 🙏 …
I always take my pup here and the staff is great and efficient.

I am so grateful to this hospital and everyone who works there. My dog ​​had emergency surgery, and thanks to God and them, everything was free, even the medication. Other vets only care about money instead of our animals, but here, you can feel the love the whole team has for animals. I will be eternally grateful to everyone for saving my baby's life. My baby is now recovered and happy.

Everyone there is truly great, from security to front desk, to nurses and doctors. Treats you respectfully and kindly while being very affordable. One can only wish this place also offered long term care for chronic conditions but they accept only 15 patients a day which is also a godsend. Have come here multiple times for urgent issues with my cats and my last time here was for my senior cat for dental work. First week, they monitored her and kept her until she was stable to go home but advised me against dental work due to the newfound blood pressure issue. Also gave me medication for a month like I requested while I save for a primary/long term care vet which will cost lots of money in NYC. Came back the next week and she was good to have surgery this time and got all her teeth like 7 extractions except 1. Got home and she wasn't doing well, not eating and vomiting so I had to come back the next week and they provided medication to make her feel better which I am still using. They go above and beyond to make you and your pet comfortable and at ease.
June 26, 2026, the date that I would never forget 🥰 My Dears 🐾🐾 finally back home👍🏻 Thank you so much for all the ASPCA Staffs helping👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻😊 …

My 10-year- old Zena Shih Tzu mix was seen there for some major Dental issues and extractions, the staff was amazing, she was sent home with antibiotics and pain medication, was seen again for more extractions. They took care of her so well they were only a phone call away if I had any questions. So now my dog is recovering at home and they did a fantastic job thank you to all the doctors, nurses reception everyone! Five stars in my book

The best place in the world, they have help me a lot in emergency situations.
I personally encourage those people who can help and donate, to do it to this place they really give our pets/family that support.
And if you really have an emergency and you are low income go there, and if you available to afford your pets needs go there too, im pretty sure that's a big help too.
Without them I don't know how I would get health care for my animals. They are the most sweetest doctors. consistently deliver exceptional results that exceed all expectations.

The ASPCA wrongfully seized and euthanized my healthy, registered service dog, Zeus.
He was not sick, not aggressive, and I did not surrender him. They killed him without my consent or due process.
This is not animal protection—this is negligence and cruelty.
Their euthanasia label is their excuse.
Do not donate to the ASPCA. Hold them accountable. They are not what they claim to be.

#JusticeForZeus #ASPCAExposed #aspcakills #justiceforthehukies #forthehuskies

I just want to say this hospital is amazing . The people go up and beyond to care for all the animals . All of the staff fron the front dest,nurses and doctors really care about all the animals that come in .They explained to me what was happening with my pets . They showed so much empathy and didnt try to over charge even though I  went to another hospital and they charged me 4000. They didnt provide the same care and all they wanted was money . Aspca kept my babies and while I lost one to parvo the other three are alive . And im so lucky for this hospital and the people in it . Thank you for saving my babies life especially my Luna ....

We had to put our baby Honey to eternal rest on 4/10/2026 she was only 2yrs and 10 months old. Everyone at the ASPCA on 92nd street was very compassionate. They prepared a special room for us to spend with her and gave us all the time we needed and never rushed us. The doctor explained the process in a very low tone and compassionate way. When we were ready the process began and our baby went to heaven without pain. We were there for a while longer with her and said our final goodbyes. The doctor once again met with us and comforted us with very kind words. I can’t thank them enough for making such a hard moment in our lives so heartfelt and comfortable. We will forever hold our baby girl Honey in our hearts and the people at the ASPCA as well. Thank you all.
One off the best services New York City offered to its residents
Terrible my dog has cancer and went for an emergency visit desperate and was dismissed and turned away!! I am disgusted
The best place for animal

ABSOLUTE ANGELS work here omg , they literally saved my pittie when every other vet gave up… they took her in the same day because it was urgent and treated her for many nights while giving updates. My dog literally didn’t want to leave because she loved it here ? ? Like what.. (she is happy at home now tho 🤍😭) But how insanely grateful I am, I literally would’ve lost my will to live if she was a goner and they saved her.!! like actual magic I dont want to mention my doctor’s name in case of privacy and all the doctor’s here are the best but she is literally who I admire so so much. I was so anxious but as soon as I saw how calm the vets and assistants were I knew that they were smart and trusted them. They gave her varieties of food even when she wouldn’t eat and toys. Even the front desk always had such positive good energy. I’ve even met other dog owners waiting for their pups and everybody was so sweet despite the painful situations. I have learned though to take care of my pup better, and get any future rescue dog spayed asap!!!  As soon as I get paid Im coming back to donate forget about my college bills because I love this place so much,, not to mention its so pretty like the cat window in the front of the building and the waiting room too..
Also please put your trust in them and be patient, they will help you and understand- they always offer you to ask questions so just communicate. If you really can’t get an appointment dont give up on your pup/cat, they are really trying the best and above. Just email all the vets in your area with the exact situation and your financial situations with proof (in my case I had ebt and my parents passed away) I submitted everything and after going to ASPCA 🤍 the vets were willing to take my pup for free as-well. keep trying because that was my back up plans if these angels hadn’t have saved me and my baby :).
I love everyone who works here even the cleaners were so sweet, may u all always be happy and healthy and rich.
I CANT GET A HOLD OF ANYONE ON THE PHONE! I'vE BEEN TRYING FOR 8 DAYS ALREADY, I REALLY NEED MY BOY TO BE SEEN ASAP . 😞 ITS RIDICULOUS.

I brought my sick cat in a couple years ago... he wasn't urinating and would occasionally lay in his litter box.  They took him in but did no treatment there because I couldn't afford to pay. They kept him 1 or 2 nights and told me to pick him up. Claimed he had a catheter in and was "urinating fine" but to pick him up because he was "stressed out" (who wouldn't pee fine with a catheter in?) I knew he would pass if he came home but they argued he would get worse there... i gave him the food they prescribed and sent him home with, and the medicine (gabapentin and something else) a no progress or recovery. They claimed he was fine. But prescribed him medicine.
3rd morning after returning he passed away.  No vet would take him over the weekend and Monday morning he passed. Brought him back here and could only get a patch of fur and a paw print which I was okay with.  But the false report of his condition when I brought him in? I can't remember all the lies on the report, but the report made it sound like he lived in poor conditions. One falsity i remember was the claim of flea dirt on him. I felt like they did that to make it seem like his passing was my fault, as if I neglected him. But I think it was cause they wanted to shift the guilt off of them for forcing him out of the hospital. Idk if anythings changed since then, I highly doubt it.  But I would have rather put my pet down that day than watch him slowly die from sepsis because I was poor and they didn't want him there. To top it all off... before walking out of the room I took his body to, I was told that this is a common occurrence in neutered cats... they develop narrow urethra. I'd wait longer or not neuter if possible, according to their behavior. My advice to avoid this happening to you. I wouldn't and havent come here again.

After 1.5 hours on hold trying to get through to someone for an apt I was super grateful to get a same day appointment. My kitten fell out the window from my apartment when I was sleeping and I was so scared for her as she was traumatized and had a cut on her face when i found her. She shivering and curled up outside in the cold crying 😔😢 everyone at this clinic has truly been god sent. The compassion, love and care they provided my kitten with was unmatched. They were so thorough and even vaccinated my fur baby as I was not able to do it before due to financial reasons. I am so grateful and thankful from the bottom of my heart to everyone who works here. Thank you guys for making sure my mama was ok. We went home feeling at peace after this stressful event. thanks to the ASPCA and All of their employees. God bless you guys

Be sure to ask many questions, maybe details of what went on in the back, you may not be paying much out of pocket, you may pay w the life of your pet. They're known to withold info, be adamant. Be sure to record convos, especially when uncomfortable
They didn't help us, and it was an emergency; now everything has changed.

But definitely it's worth it. We have call at Thursday, and at Saturday we already visited hospital for first examination and at next Thursday we already had surgery.

My pups currently have parvo virus.   I've been back and forth all week.  And they also saved my sister pup

This place is a blessing , the staff is always amazing
I Am So Grateful For Yall Thank You Please Call And Set Up An Appointment Make Sure Call Early They Are Wonderful Thank You Can’t Wait To Bring My Other Dog!

My mother just called at 2:48am December 1st and was worried about our cat right now because it looks like he has a blockage. The girl on the phone was very rude and laughed at my mother. My mother was just asking what to do and see if they can do something because we didn’t want our cat to suffer and needed a cheaper option. She just laughed and was being sarcastic. She wouldn’t give us her name and was VERY disrespectful. She said they couldn’t do anything because he wasn’t adopted from the aspca. Very disappointed and hope she gets fired!😡
Animal hospital on 92nd Street in Manhattan always took very good care

ASPCA has been a Godsend! This was my second time utilizing their services and I am amazed again. It is a bit challenging to get an appointment, but when you do they truly work with you to get your FurBaby Happy and Healthy! Two of my cats needed to have teeth removed. In total I paid under $450 to have multiple teeth removed, bloodwork, ex-rays and teeth cleaning. In addition, I've used their mobile services to get my Babies spayed and neutered. Just follow the instructions online to secure an app. It's $125 which is a steal compared to private vets. The staff is out of this world; They are attentive, kind, knowledgable in their field and compassionate! I can't afford a lot, but I will be making monthly donations even if it's five dollars. Please donate as much as you can even if it's a dollar! Our Furry Friends will truly appreciate it!

⭐☆☆☆☆
Heartbreaking Experience — They Failed My Pet

I’m beyond disappointed and angry with the ASPCA on 92nd St. The first doctor I saw focused only on my cat Zoey’s jaw and told me I should consider putting her down, either now or later. That was their solution. I was referred by a friend to an oral surgeon who was able to fix her jaw in one day just by looking at the x-rays and seeing zoey in person the day before.

When I brought Zoey back a few days later to have her stints and cast changed (since all four of her paws are broken from her fall), a different doctor saw her and immediately told me how severe her paw injuries were. I asked why no one mentioned this the first time, and she said the note in my file claimed I couldn’t afford surgery. That’s completely untrue and, even if it were, I should have been told the full extent of her injuries from the start.

Once again, they told me Zoey “wouldn’t have a good quality of life” and suggested I think about putting her down  instead of actually trying to help her heal. This place showed zero compassion, poor communication, and made me feel like giving up was my only option. I also asked to be referred somewhere else for her stint and cast changes because I had to come back not ONCE not TWICE but THREE times in the same day to get her cast replaced when I just came on WEDNESDAY and paid to get them changed. In less than 2 days her cast were coming off. I had to travel back and forth the WHOLE day because the cast were not placed right. Then they tried to say it was Zoey who kept taking them off. Zoey cannot open her jaw and has cast and stints on the rest of her paws so it is very hard for her to try and take them off. The ASPCA really disappointed me because I donate money every month and thought I could put my trust in their care for my baby. I’m definitely going to look into finding another animal clinic that can help my baby in the way that she needs. This experience has been absolutely horrible and I wouldn’t recommend this ASPCA at all.

My dog has to wear a cone,so do to that he has a bad ear infection they said they can't treat him because the reason he has a ear infection is because he has allergies, my dog never had a ear infection until he started wearing a cone and he hasn't eaten or drank water in two days they said they can't help with that because it caused by the ear infection

They take good care of your pets WHEN you finally get an appointment BUT their appointment system is the WORST! I tried calling for my dog that was having some episodes and was told on Friday to call Monday. I started calling for an appointment at 7:55am. I would hang up and call back within seconds. While I was on the phone at 7:59-8:00am it was STILL saying the line was closed. Called back at 8:01am and to my surprise the recording says "unfortunately all appointments are booked"!!! How is it possible for all appointments to be booked within seconds?!  What is going on with the phone center?!! Manhattan needs MORE pet resources. While the other boroughs have vans, Manhattan has that sucky phone system that is like trying to visit the land of Oz. Not sure if they think Manhattan is looked at as the wealthy borough but it's not! Then they have the nerve to have the young people out on the streets asking for donations. If I give you a donation would you help my pet in return? I may also add, the times my pet was attended I paid.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars
I want to thank everyone at the ASPCA Animal Hospital for being so kind and caring with my dog, Mia. She had an emergency operation, and the team was amazing from beginning to end. Everyone went above and beyond to help her. I’m so grateful to all of you for saving my dog’s life. Thank you so much for everything you do — you are truly angels!

I am so incredibly grateful; this clinic is a blessing. My cat was very ill; I thought he would die that night. Other vets would ask if I could pay first, but here they just took my cat in and gave him the best possible care. He was hospitalized for three days, and now he's home with us. They gave him his medication to continue his treatment. Everyone at the clinic is very professional, and above all, they treated us with compassion. Everyone was so kind. Thank you so much for taking care of my baby, Locky, who is the most grateful to feel better. Don't hesitate to bring your pets here.

Can’t even schedule an appointment with them over the phone just get referred to a machine went in person for my severely ill kitten since no one was able to help (been to 3 different places) only to get turned away rudely and given the same phone number.
Took my cat(s) there many times. 👍 …

They made me go to an outside vet with a cat on death’s door.  The vet managed to get a couple thousand out of me on care credit before my cat was laid to rest by a different vet. I used to be a regular donator but I haven’t   donated to ASPCA since then. The staff attitude was unforgivable.
Took care of our pop
Really shouldn't be so complicated to schedule an appt. Dr. Riley was direct and helpful. Wish they had more support so they can extend their services.
My dog was very very sick two years ago almost close too death and they heal her she had surgery now I’m facing new challenges help please can’t get through too talking too anyone
Impossible to get an appointment.  Could care less of the condition of the dog.

After several visits to my local veterinary offices and several hundred dollars we admitted and accepted that our Lucy was not getting better.  She was not eating, losing weight and extremely emaciated. My husband and I agreed to put her down and called the ASPCA where we had rescued her 10 years earlier.   On my arrival I was put in the Zen room as was bawling my eyes out saying my goodbyes.  However the vet that came in was Dr. Cassano. She was so empathetic and took the time to review Lucy’s records and suggested “one more thing” for us to try.  I cannot praise her enough.  She recommended a steroid, an antibiotic and a gel for her ear. I am happy to report that my Lucy is thriving after 3 weeks and I will be forever grateful to Dr.Cassano.  This young lady is on her way to big things.  May God bless her every day.  She literally saved my cats life in that one visit.  We will forever be grateful to her and the ASPCA.  We commend her highly.
Eternally grateful, Norma Villalta and Lucy ❤️

This place is Not for the community as they say. It's only for whom they choose to make acceptable, they never answer the phones or return call backs.. I've  been waiting on a call back for months now. Honestly I don't think anyone should donate to this facility with the lack of companion they claim for animals

They did a great job checking up on my cat, but this situation is really frustrating. My cat has an emergency and needs an FHO surgery, yet all I’m being told is that the surgeon won’t be available for a couple of weeks, and the earliest surgery date they can offer is in a few months. This is unacceptable for a cat with a dislocated leg and a damaged hip.

He is already on pain medication almost every day, and I’m concerned about how long he will need to remain on it. I chose ASPCA because the cost of the surgery is much lower than elsewhere, but the delay feels unprofessional and puts my cat’s recovery at risk. Prolonging the surgery could lead to further complications, such as weakness in his leg or arthritis, and make rehabilitation more difficult.

This surgery is expensive, yes, but it is not a procedure that should take months to schedule. I’m very concerned about my cat’s well-being and hope this can be addressed more urgently.

Everyone here is so nice, it's my first time coming here because my cat had a limp. Called at 8am and got an appointment for the next day for 8am, the waiting room was spacious and extremely clean and front desk were kind and fast with the process. I only waited 30ish minutes to be called because higher emergency takes priority which is understandable and I did not mind. There's a dog section and cat section that I did not know until I left 😅

The only thing that I did not realize until I got home with my cat was that while the vet explained everything while checking my cat and all, did not explain thoroughly of the side affects the opioid would do to my cat, only told me the drug name and advising for me to not touch it. However I should've asked myself the side effects as well, so that was also on me, my cat is now doing slightly better but is still a space cat. She did however explain thoroughly everything else such as the bloodwork, feeling my cat, etc

But I also liked how they called me to update her on the results the next day and checking up to see on how my cat is doing/feeling. Overall I really liked the vets and how the treated me and my cat with kindness and patience, as well as front desk. It felt very comfortable there, I got sent with pain killers for her which I will start giving her once the opioid is out of her system. I recommend this place to anyone if their pet has a emergency that needs to be checked within the week ❤️

Update:
It's been more than a week or two now and my cat is much better, no longer has the limp and the drug wore off about 3 days after. However she's now way more affectionate compared to before, still bites hard when playing but REALLY likes pets now. Back then she would only let me pet her for a few seconds and then bite me. But now she comes to my hand and sleeps on my arm
They are the best

Dr. J. Fenichel X

We sincerely appreciate the care and evaluation the doctor was able to provide to her availability. However, we were instructed to follow the instructions in how to administer the medications to our Tiny in which we did, which in turn after a few days of seeing a lot of progress in Tiny she relapsed!! We managed to rush Tiny to a veterinarian as an emergency walk in. The vet examined Tiny even further and prescribed a different antibiotic with a slight higher dose, and the vet said to also use the lactulose.
Now, the instructions on administering the lactulose is completely different from I was instructed by the aspca pharmacist, which caused so much harm to Tiny because If your pharmacist and doctor would've instructed the same so much could've been avoided!!!
As doctors don't limit your knowledge.
Share all you know to save the lives of animals. Also, don't be so quick to recommend euthanasia!! I understand euthanasia is only for extreme situations not a coward and lazy way out from responsibilities!!
Love them
Never able to give an appointment.if you trying to spay and neuter which is highly recommended then work with us.No wonder is an over population of dogs and cats.Can really do better.

I was looking for a low cost facility to take my two pets.. After seeing the reviews. I changed my mind, especially the cat behavior after being treated..As well the owner response when others are speaking their mind … His belly is full he doesn’t  care … if he gets good reviews or not…
In life you get what you paid for…. Bottom line… My pet  deserves the best …

Additional: I was also dissatisfied with the female receptionist and the female security guard: they did not know the hospital's services and actually told me that the hospital did not offer cesarean sections! Fortunately, I got an appointment for surgery the next day.

The stray cat my mom rescued unexpectedly became pregnant. When she started bleeding, I rushed her to a mobile veterinary clinic for a prenatal checkup. The vet told me she needed an emergency C-section—and the cost would be $1,750, which I simply couldn’t afford.

Thanks to a suggestion from ChatGPT, I reached out to the ASPCA for help. To my surprise, they scheduled the surgery the very same day, and based on my income, I only needed to pay $212.50. I was overjoyed and so relieved for my cat!

Dr. An，the veterinarian, was incredibly kind and patient. He even arranged interpreter services to make sure I fully understood the medical terms. The surgery went smoothly, and the very next day, Dr. An called to let me bring home the proud new mama and her tiny kittens.

I am deeply grateful to the entire ASPCA team for their compassion and dedication. Because of them, my cat and her babies are safe and healthy. I hope to give back in the future by donating to the ASPCA, so this circle of kindness can continue. ❤️
